evidence: This survey aims to address this gap by providing a comprehensive review of machine learning-based Network Intrusion Detection Systems
This section presents a detailed review of both traditional and DL-NIDS, categorized by learning approach
This section presents an analytical study of existing research on methods for generating adversarial examples that evade ML-NIDS
This survey provides a comprehensive and current analysis of adversarial attacks... with a specific focus on network intrusion detection systems
unresolved: Paper is a pure survey/position paper with no original experiments, models, datasets, seeds, or evaluation metrics of its own -- all numeric/methodological content (Tables 1-4) summarizes properties of OTHER papers it reviews, not results the authors themselves produced. All numeric fields set to null per instructions.

reports_variability and control_arm left null rather than 'none' because the paper does not report any experimental results at all, so the concept does not apply (not merely absent from an experiment).
